QuestInfo.name: [Ariant] Gardin's Report
QuestInfo.1: The Alliance is busy dealing with the aftermath of Hilla spreading anti-aging medicine. #bQueen Areda#k of Ariant is purchasing the medicine in bulk. Neinheart reveals that her entire identity is a fabrication. He asks you to keep watch on her and cooperate with the local militia, the #bSand Bandits#k.
QuestInfo.2: You were urgently dispatched to Ariant and met Jano, the leader of the Sand Bandits.
QuestInfo.0: Neinheart makes a sudden call. Gardin the informant has suspicions about Queen #bAreda#k of Ariant...
